title: File:USS Mount Whitney (LCC 20) ship makes port in Constanta, Romania (6990150).jpg
art: U.S. Navy USNFE-6FPA by Petty Officer 2nd Class Scott Barnes
desc: Constanta, Romania - The Blue Ridge-class command and control ship USS Mount Whitney (LCC 20) ship makes port in Constanta, Romania, November 12, 2021. Mount Whitney is the U.S. Sixth Fleet flagship, homeported in Gaeta, and operates with a combined crew of U.S. Sailors and Military Sealift Command
